name: Three-gate benchmark for short-term earthquake forecasting in the eastern Indian plate margin
description: Analysis code and archived earthquake catalog for the paper "Clustering Persistence Dominates Apparent Precursory Skill: A Three-Gate Benchmark for Short-Term Earthquake Forecasting in the Eastern Indian Plate Margin". The pipeline (nine Python scripts run by run_pipeline.py) builds 20-event sequences from the USGS ComCat catalog for 10-30°N, 85-98°E, 1973-2025 (7,175 events), labels them for the occurrence of an M ≥ 4.5 event within 15 days and 100 km, and evaluates a random-forest detector under purged forward-chaining validation against a training-free Omori-type clustering benchmark, a low-clustering stratification and an event-level coverage audit. The archive contains the exact catalog retrieval analyzed in the paper with its SHA-256 manifest, the map layers used in Figure 1, all scripts, fixed random seeds and a pinned environment (requirements.txt). Running "python run_pipeline.py --skip-download" regenerates every table and figure in the paper and its electronic supplement.
